scope: CPU synthetic source-trained linear-adapter family + exact joint source-only codec; not natural LLM or original paper reproduction
hypothesis: At actual physical full-codec bytes and calibrated output distortion, small Mirror orientation codes can sometimes save bytes on orbit-aligned function families beyond native directly quantized updates, but may be dominated by an ordinary source-trained linear dictionary; joint method/bit/private selection can beat single-axis restriction without being Mirror-specific.

worlds.activation_cross_block_covariance: X mixed with fixed dense invertible matrix; source-only dev probes supply Gram matrix, never audit

optimization.baseline_state_selection: compute best no-Mirror exact joint candidate under same serializer/budget, and best fixed-one-method across blocks
optimization.codec: portable custom binary exact serializer struct header + per-block tag/scale/int-packed code/mask; use actual len(bytes) and exact decoder, not npz logical tensor sizes
optimization.all_candidates: development-only low code fit to source/test support, same fits for native + Mirror; no target audit used to fit
optimization.loss: squared output error averaged over 6 roles and heldout X. Cross-block X^T X interactions included, independent block approximation diagnostic only

decision.PASS: Across >=4/5 fresh worlds at >=1 viable budget ratio Mirror-enabled joint codec gives >=2% lower true heldout MSE than best no-Mirror joint at <=same physical bytes, and decoder output roundtrip exactly; no source/audit leakage; full end-to-end runtime <=1.10 native.
decision.FAIL: No improvement over best native linear/direct joint codec, advantage only relative to naive diagonal/coordinate optimizer, wrong byte accounting or privately paid basis omitted.
decision.UNCERTAIN: a fresh world has no feasible baseline under hard bytes, support and oracle mismatch or CPU timing dominated by Python decoder; status remains UNTESTED until independent natural task replication.

checks: bits2/4/8 unpack roundtrip and payload corruption
all codec choices valid and binary lengths exact
full Gram distortion equals heldout predictions
source-only dictionary/code fitting verified by train/test leakage test
same full-codec byte budget for all methods
measure: all source/dev/fresh per-world outcomes, true MSE vs exact controls, physical codec bytes, selected methods/bits/private, additive-vs-coupled false-pass, CPU decode time per six role outputs, planned vs actual state count
limitations: Aligned teacher is intentionally favorable; full native per-role 8-bit bank is strong baseline but regular linear dictionary can be equally efficient. Not a general model compression theorem.
hardware: numpy2.3.5 scipy1.17 CPU float64; OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1, no CUDA; report wall but no production inference throughput.
policy: no existing worker queue/status changes; store results under intake rather than finalized MA experiment directory
